description: Bicycle Network - Blue Mountains is a dataset listed in Blue Mountains City Council open data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Western Parkland Councils. A database of cycleway infrastructure located in Western Parkland Councils maintained by Roads and Maritime Services. Coverage: Blue Mountains, New South Wales. The portal files it under Roads, Parking and Transport. Its keywords are cycle, paths, bike. The portal shows 235 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bmcc-nsw-gov-au-portal.
